about: Addresses written into agent scripts before checks/addresses.mjs held them to Common Agent 12.6 rule 2 and the address check of 12.10. Each entry is a file, an address in it, and what it is. The list only shrinks: take an entry off when its address is read from a setting instead, and never add one.
